Maintain accurate payroll documentation and support internal and external audits. Collaborate with Finance and Accounting on payroll reporting, journal entries, accruals, and reconciliations. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting payroll across the US, Canada, UK, and/or European countries. Experience working with global payroll providers, EOR platforms, and managed payroll solutions. Familiarity with payroll accounting, general ledger reconciliations, and payroll funding. Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.
